title: Reminders by Telegram and email
intro: Besides notifications on this computer, the app can send deadline reminders to your phone. Each channel stays off until you turn it on.
lastError: The last message failed: {{reason}} The app will try again.

telegram.title: Telegram
telegram.missing: Save the bot token and chat ID first to turn this on.
telegram.howTo: How to get a bot token and chat ID

howToSteps.one: In Telegram, open @BotFather, send /newbot and give the bot a name.
howToSteps.two: BotFather answers with a token like 123456789:AA…; paste it into Bot token and press Save.
howToSteps.three: Open the chat with your bot and press Start (a bot can only message people who pressed Start).
howToSteps.four: Open @userinfobot and press Start: it answers with your Id; paste that number into Chat ID.

telegram.consent: When on, the app sends the deadline title, due date and note path to chat {{chatId}} through Telegram's servers.
telegram.consentNoChat: When on, the app sends the deadline title, due date and note path to the chat you enter below, through Telegram's servers.

email.title: Email
email.missing: Fill in the SMTP server, sender and recipient (and the password if there is a user name) first to turn this on.
email.userHint: Leave empty if the server needs no login.
email.passwordHint: For Gmail, use an app password, not your main password.
email.consent: When on, the app sends the deadline title, due date and note path to {{to}} through the server {{host}}.
email.consentIncomplete: When on, the app sends the deadline title, due date and note path to the recipient, through the SMTP server you enter below.
email.securityHint: No encryption works only with a server on this computer.

failure.auth: Telegram did not accept the bot token. Check the token from @BotFather.
failure.chat-not-found: Telegram cannot find this chat, or you have not pressed Start in the bot. Check the chat ID and press Start.
failure.rate-limit: Telegram is limiting messages. Wait a minute and try again.
failure.network: the connection failed. Check the network and try again.
failure.timeout: the server did not answer in time. Try again in a few minutes.
failure.smtp-auth: the email server did not accept the user name or password.
failure.smtp-connect: the email server could not be reached. Check the server, port and security setting.
failure.rejected: the email server refused the message. Check the sender and recipient addresses.
failure.not-configured: fill in every field of this channel first.
failure.busy: another test message is being sent.
failure.failed: something unexpected went wrong. Try again in a few minutes.
failure.tls-required: this server is not on your computer, so it cannot be used without encryption. Choose STARTTLS or TLS.

saveErrors.chat-id-format: A chat ID is a number (groups start with -) or @channelname.
saveErrors.bot-token-format: A bot token looks like 123456789:AA… Paste the whole token from @BotFather again.
saveErrors.host-format: Enter a server name, for example smtp.gmail.com (no https:// and no port).
saveErrors.email-format: Enter one email address, for example you@school.edu.
saveErrors.control-characters: The value contains characters that cannot be used.
saveErrors.out-of-range: The value is outside the allowed range.
saveErrors.pattern: This value does not have the right form.
saveErrors.tls-required: Choose No encryption only for an SMTP server on this computer (localhost, 127.0.0.1). For any other server choose STARTTLS or TLS, so your password is never sent unencrypted.
